name: Reincorporation

subjectOf.text: Mobility costs for a corporation are probably higher when changing the jurisdiction of incorporation means changing not only the applicable corporate law but also the courts that will apply it.
subjectOf.abstract: Finally, mobility costs are probably higher if changing jurisdictions of incorporation means changing not just the applicable corporate law, but also the courts that will apply that law.
subjectOf.citation: Christian Kirchner, Richard W. Painter, Wulf A. Kaal, Regulatory Competition in EU Corporate Law after Inspire Art Unbundling Delaware's Product for Euro (2004). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=617681

subjectOf.text: European lawyers may advise clients to incorporate at home simply because those lawyers do not want to deal with the courts and lawyers of another Member State, which suppresses cross border incorporation independently of statute quality.
subjectOf.abstract: European lawyers thus may advise clients to incorporate at home simply because these lawyers do not want to deal with the courts and lawyers of another Member State.
